lia-marketing: Hey team — quick ask for the launch blog + webinar. Can runtime produce a tiny 'minipack' we can hand to reporters and demo engineers?

owen-runtime: Yep. What should the minipack include?

lia-marketing: Keep it minimal: 4 payloads (very short, short, median, long), a CSV of timings, one trace showing cold start, one trace steady-state, and a one-paragraph 'how we ran it' note. Also a 2-line press-ready blurb with exact numbers we can quote.

priya-eng: Which model/infra to run on? Hosted benchmark or dedicated hardware?

lia-marketing: Prefer the demo model (rwd-lite-3b) on dedicated-gpu-21 so numbers are stable. If dedicated isn't available, note hosted variant and any rate limits.

owen-runtime: Plan: micro-sweep on rwd-lite-3b, 500 requests, batches disabled, warmup 50 requests, collect p50/p95/p99 and tokens_per_sec. I'll include a provenance.txt with machine image, driver, and docker tag. ETA 24 hours.

demo-ops: Can you also add a runbook snippet for local reproduction? We need a curl and a small shell helper.

owen-runtime: Sure. I'll drop /demo/run-local.sh and example curl. Example in pack: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"model":"rwd-lite-3b","input":"Summarize: ..."}'

lia-marketing: Great. Important: if int8 quantized run is flaky, include the raw numbers and label as 'preliminary'. We must not overclaim. Also include a tiny note about variance (sd) at p95.

owen-runtime: Will do. If quantized variance >15% vs fp16, I'll mark as noisy and include the raw traces.

bench-bot: micro-bench queued (#7739) by owen-runtime. Logs: /bench/7739. Estimated runtime 2h.

lia-marketing: Awesome — if anything slips, flag us immediately. We'll cut the long payload if you need to speed up. Thanks :rocket:

priya-eng: minor nit — please capture the exact sequence length distribution in the README (counts per bucket). That helps marketing avoid misleading averages.

owen-runtime: Good call, will include counts for <=64, 65-512, 513-2048.

demo-ops: also request: include a tiny CSV with the 4 payloads and expected tokens_out so demos can assert outputs.

owen-runtime: Added. Final deliverables: tar.gz with payloads.csv, timings.csv, traces.tar, provenance.txt, README.md, demo/run-local.sh, press_blurb.txt.

lia-marketing: Perfect. Thank you!

bench-bot: micro-bench #7739 completed. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/7739/artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: ab12cd...).
